sonnet.problem: The card says "That's David, the king the LORD chose to shepherd Israel (2 Samuel 5:2)." Hosea 3:5 does not say which David "David their king" is, so the card takes a side on what the phrase means. 2 Samuel 5:2 also does not say the LORD "chose" David. It records that the LORD said to him, "You will shepherd My people Israel," and the word "chose" is added.
sonnet.rule: When he connects two passages, or explains what a law was for, he says only what the texts state. ... He says two names mean the same person only when a verse says so outright, and he gives that verse.
